GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out .5 Lengths Settled Down 2nd 1 Lengths 800m 4th 3 Lengths home turn 3rd Hooked Out Middle Of Track weakened final 200m # every ch/weak late

Jumped only fairly then hampered, missed it 2 Lengths and Settled Down a clear last 15 Lengths from the lead, trailed 12 Lengths and still last approaching turn, shifted 3 Wide into turn, steered inwards Straightening Up and piloted through gaps still steering inwards, on the (after cutaway) rail at 140m, blocked until the 100m, lost momentum and not knocked around from there to line. (Cross-over Nose Band OFF FIRST TIME) # Had excuses
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began only fairly & was checked from heels shortly after. Between the 300m and 150m shifted in a number of horses, under pressure, whilst attempting to obtain clear running. Approaching the 100m was steadied in around heels before being further steadied after improving into a narrow run. Stwds advised rdr his mount would have been better served shifting out into clear running available near the 300m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only fairly then very slow into stride (-2 lengths), Settled Down last 12 Lengths from the lead, made no ground to Turn then Made Ground close to fence in straight. (Cross-over Nose Band FIRST TIME) [Stewards questioned rider re settling back and becoming detached in the middle stages. App. jockey stated he intended settling forward however, it was restless in the barrier, began awkwardly and missed the start 2 lengths, got out of its ground early/middle stages but found the line well when fully pressured in the straight.] # got a long way back
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Eased near 900m. App stated wanted to race fwd however mount began awkwardly & lost ground (~2L). App stated mount got out of ground in e&m stages despite him encouraging it along, whilst endeavoring to keep on bridle. App stated mount had a high head carriage during this time giving him the impression it resented the XNB which it was wearing for 1st time. App added mount found line nicely in straight. Stewards counselled app & advised he should have made greater effort to improve onto back of field between 600m & 400m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Began OK. Pushed fwd early & raced 5th Two Wide (2.5L from lead). Stayed same until pushed to quicken @ 400m. Pressured 3 Wide (3L from lead) on home turn. Gave ground Two Wide in straight. Rider - made abnormal respiratory noise/vetted clear. # didn't finish off
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Passing the 800m was steadied when placed in restricted room. A post-race vet exam revealed no abs. Rider reported abnormal respiratory noise. Trainer was told a vet clearance including scope will be required. Vet clearance since received.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well , Settled Down Two Wide 5th Just 3 Lengths @ 800m. nicely into Clear early Straight . Set  out chasing but $8.50 winner (sat 2nd) held him off # Sound in defeat
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Had difficulty obtaining clear running in the early part of the straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 4th 2 lengths. 4th turn tracking leaders. hooked 4 Wide in Straight . raced away # had the run

Jumped evenly. Pushed fwd & worked to share lead Two Wide early . Stayed =lead Two Wide midrace & held together =lead 3 Wide on home turn. Pushed along @ 400m & hit lead @ 300m. Pressured @ 250m & fought on until faded in last 50m. # On-pace/faded

Bit Slow Out before Improved 3 Wide 3rd 2l. No Cover . slotted in soon after. Ridden Along peeling 3 Wide again to Turn . Straightened Up 2 Lengths away chasing, Battled On Well and very honest, winner too strong # sound/every chance
